reviews.title: Violation???
reviews.text:
I played for a week, game is fun and grindy, until one day I got banned because “Violation of Operational Policy”. What the f*ck? I play this game without using macro, only 1 device (this phone) and no cheat too, and then one day I got banned at 4am in my local time, when im soundly asleep and did nothing with the game.

Then I email support to ask for help, but a week later and still no reply, no bot message, no nothing. I linked my gmail account to the game and yet the same gmail account does not receive any email explaining why I am banned.

0/10 bad game, a waste of your time, don’t even bother download this.
